user.title: Comelit VIPER
user.description:
Configure your Comelit video intercom.

You need the **user token** from the device. You can obtain it by capturing traffic between the Comelit app and the intercom. See the [guide](https://github.com/madchicken/comelit-client/wiki/Get-your-user-token-for-ICONA-communication).

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the device. Check the IP address and that the device is reachable.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Check the user token.
